name: heads-up
description: Watches the running session and shows a heads-up when something is off: failing tools or tests in a row, edits outside the project, a context spike, or a run that stalls.

failureStreak.title: Failed tool calls in a row
failureStreak.description: Show a heads-up after this many failed tool calls in a row. 0 turns it off.

testFailures.title: Failed test runs in a row
testFailures.description: Show a heads-up after this many failed test runs in a row (npm test, pytest, cargo test, ...). 0 turns it off.

contextJumpTokens.title: Context jump in one turn (tokens)
contextJumpTokens.description: Show a heads-up when a single turn adds at least this many tokens to the context. 0 turns it off.

contextPercent.title: Context fill warning (%)
contextPercent.description: Show a heads-up when the context window passes this share (a second one at 95%). 0 turns it off.

stallMinutes.title: Stalled run (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: Show a heads-up when a tool call has no result, or a running turn shows no activity, for this long. 0 turns it off.

repeatCalls.title: Same call and result in a row
repeatCalls.description: Show a heads-up when the same tool call returns the same result this many times in a row. 0 turns it off.

watchEdits.title: Edits outside the project
watchEdits.description: Show a heads-up when Edit, Write or NotebookEdit targets a file outside the project folder.

ignorePaths.title: Paths that are fine to edit
ignorePaths.description: Comma-separated folders that never trigger the outside-the-project heads-up. ~ is your home folder; the system temp folder is always included.

notify.title: Native notification
notify.description: Also send a native notification for warnings and alerts, so a stalled run reaches you when you are away from the window.
